title: Dependency graph legibility
summary: The dependency graph now packs mid-level views to the viewport, draws two-line boxes with distinct, size-aware folders, groups neighbors by package then file, takes color and LOC from the treemap, and spreads edge bundles. Reconciled against origin/main 0bfb05ba.
follow_ups: Peripheral ideas C13-C15 (peek in context, surface a folder's most-used items, quieter dashed edges) were not planned milestones. Later work covers part of them: expand in place (#84, #91) and hub badges (#64).

title: Compare ref picker: PRs, worktrees, commits
summary: Compare now resolves pr:<n> refs through a gh seam with phase timings, offers a picker over PRs, worktrees and branches, compares another worktree on disk as the head, and steps through a PR commit by commit. Reconciled against origin/main 0bfb05ba.
follow_ups: Evaluate dependency compare on a real PR (claim C7). Nothing tracks it.

title: Unified navigation
summary: Treemap zoom and graph focus are now one URL location with real Back, refresh and compare keep the repo, a History dropdown lists recent places, and one view switch plus visible node actions replace the old controls. Reconciled against origin/main 0bfb05ba.
follow_ups: Peripheral idea C8 (animated canvas transition between treemap and graph) was never planned and is not tracked.

title: Dependency and treemap quick fixes
summary: Opening code from the graph now uses the app's code viewer at the right scope, the graph has a legend and no side headers, the treemap has dark mono labels and a stronger ramp, popovers open one at a time, and the code viewer shows one table of applicable metrics. Reconciled against origin/main 0bfb05ba.

title: Metric system overhaul

reason: All seven milestones merged on 2026-10-16 (#73-#79); the map already recorded completion.
